starters-adj.definition: a small word that joins two things, like cats and dogs
starters-adj.definitionVi: và — nối hai thứ với nhau
starters-adj.hint: Say 'bread and butter' — 'and' links the two foods.
starters-adj.fact: You use 'and' many times when you tell a story.

starters-add.definition: to put one thing with another to make more
starters-add.hint: We add numbers in maths class.
starters-add.fact: Two plus two adds up to four!

starters-afternoon.definition: the time after lunch until the evening
starters-afternoon.definitionVi: buổi chiều, sau giờ ăn trưa
starters-afternoon.hint: School often finishes in the afternoon.
starters-afternoon.fact: The sun is still bright in the afternoon.

starters-again.definition: one more time, like doing something twice
starters-again.hint: Say 'again' when you want another turn.
starters-again.fact: Reading a story again helps you remember the words.

starters-alien.definition: a creature from another planet in space stories
starters-alien.definitionVi: người ngoài hành tinh trong truyện vũ trụ
starters-alien.hint: Aliens often have big eyes in cartoons.
starters-alien.fact: No one has met a real alien yet!

starters-alphabet.definition: all the letters from A to Z that we write with
starters-alphabet.definitionVi: bảng chữ cái từ A đến Z
starters-alphabet.hint: Sing the alphabet song to learn the order.

starters-ame.definition: the word people call you, like Tom or Linh
starters-ame.hint: Write your name at the top of your worksheet.
starters-ame.fact: Every name is special — no two people in class need the same one.

starters-angry.definition: when someone feels very cross and upset
starters-angry.hint: Take a deep breath when you feel angry.
starters-angry.fact: Talking about your feelings can help anger go away.

starters-animal.definition: a living thing that moves and is not a plant
starters-animal.hint: Dogs, cats and birds are all animals.
starters-animal.fact: Some animals live in the sea and some live on land.

starters-answer.definition: what you say or write when a question is asked
starters-answer.definitionVi: câu trả lời khi thầy cô hỏi
starters-answer.hint: Put up your hand before you give an answer.
starters-answer.fact: A good answer often starts with the question words.

starters-apartment.definition: a home in a tall building with many other homes
starters-apartment.hint: People in cities often live in apartments.
starters-apartment.fact: Apartments can be on high floors with great views.

starters-apple.definition: a round crunchy fruit that is often red or green
starters-apple.definitionVi: quả táo, ăn giòn và ngọt
starters-apple.hint: An apple a day keeps the doctor away!
starters-apple.fact: Apples can float in water because they have air inside.

starters-arm.definition: the part of your body from your shoulder to your hand
starters-arm.definitionVi: cánh tay, từ vai đến bàn tay
starters-arm.hint: You wave hello with your arm.
starters-arm.fact: Your arm helps you hug people you love.

starters-armchair.definition: a comfortable chair with rests for your arms
starters-armchair.definitionVi: ghế bành có chỗ kê tay
starters-armchair.hint: Grandpa loves reading in his armchair.
starters-armchair.fact: Armchairs are soft and cosy for watching TV.

starters-ask.definition: to say a question because you want to know something
starters-ask.hint: It is okay to ask the teacher for help.
starters-ask.fact: Asking questions is how we learn new things.

starters-baby.definition: a very young child who cannot walk or talk yet
starters-baby.definitionVi: em bé, con nhỏ mới sinh
starters-baby.hint: Babies drink milk and sleep a lot.
starters-baby.fact: Babies learn to smile before they learn to talk.

starters-badminton.definition: a game where you hit a shuttlecock over a net
starters-badminton.definitionVi: cầu lông, đánh cầu qua lưới
starters-badminton.hint: Badminton uses a light feather shuttlecock.
starters-badminton.fact: Badminton is a very fast racket sport.

starters-bag.definition: something you carry books and things in
starters-bag.hint: Pack your bag the night before school.
starters-bag.fact: A school bag keeps your books dry and safe.

starters-ball.definition: a round object that you throw, kick or catch in games
starters-ball.hint: Football, basketball and tennis all use a ball.
starters-ball.fact: Balls can be made of rubber, leather or plastic.

starters-balloon.definition: a thin rubber bag filled with air that floats up
starters-balloon.definitionVi: bong bóng bay, thổi phồng bằng không khí
starters-balloon.hint: Balloons are popular at birthday parties.
starters-balloon.fact: Helium balloons float because the gas is lighter than air.

starters-banana.definition: a long yellow fruit with soft sweet inside
starters-banana.definitionVi: quả chuối vàng, ăn mềm ngọt
starters-banana.fact: Bananas grow in bunches on tall plants.

starters-baseball.definition: a bat-and-ball game where you run around four bases
starters-baseball.definitionVi: bóng chày, đánh bóng và chạy vòng
starters-baseball.hint: In baseball you hit the ball with a bat.
starters-baseball.fact: Baseball is very popular in America and Japan.

starters-baseball-cap.definition: a cloth hat with a stiff front peak on top
starters-baseball-cap.hint: Many sports teams wear matching baseball caps.
starters-baseball-cap.fact: The peak on a cap helps shade your eyes from the sun.

starters-basketball.definition: a game where you throw a ball through a high hoop
starters-basketball.definitionVi: bóng rổ, ném bóng vào rổ cao
starters-basketball.hint: Dribble the ball before you shoot in basketball.
starters-basketball.fact: Basketball hoops are three metres high!

starters-bat-as-sports-equipment.definition: a stick used to hit a ball in games like baseball
starters-bat-as-sports-equipment.definitionVi: gậy đánh bóng trong bóng chày
starters-bat-as-sports-equipment.hint: Hold the bat with both hands when you swing.
starters-bat-as-sports-equipment.fact: Cricket bats are flat but baseball bats are round.

starters-bath.definition: washing your body in a tub full of warm water
starters-bath.definitionVi: tắm bồn, ngâm mình trong nước ấm
starters-bath.hint: Rubber ducks are fun toys for bath time.
starters-bath.fact: A bubble bath makes lots of white foam on top.

starters-bathroom.definition: the room where you wash and use the toilet
starters-bathroom.definitionVi: phòng tắm và nhà vệ sinh
starters-bathroom.hint: Always wash your hands after using the bathroom.
starters-bathroom.fact: Most bathrooms have a sink, toilet and shower or bath.

starters-beach.definition: sandy ground beside the sea where people play
starters-beach.definitionVi: bãi biển cát bên bờ biển
starters-beach.hint: You can build sandcastles at the beach.
starters-beach.fact: Waves bring shells and seaweed onto the beach.

starters-bean.definition: a small seed that you cook and eat in meals
starters-bean.definitionVi: hạt đậu, nấu ăn rất bổ
starters-bean.hint: Baked beans are a popular breakfast food in the UK.
starters-bean.fact: Beans come in many colours like green, black and white.

starters-bear.definition: a big furry wild animal that eats fish and berries
starters-bear.hint: Teddy bears are soft toys shaped like bears.
starters-bear.fact: Bears sleep all winter in a cosy den.

starters-beautiful.definition: when something looks very pretty and nice to see
starters-beautiful.hint: Flowers and rainbows can look beautiful.
starters-beautiful.fact: Sunsets paint the sky in beautiful orange and pink.

starters-bed.definition: the furniture you sleep on at night
starters-bed.hint: Make your bed every morning to keep your room tidy.
starters-bed.fact: Most people sleep seven to nine hours in bed each night.

starters-bedroom.definition: the room in your home where you sleep
starters-bedroom.hint: Your toys and clothes might stay in your bedroom.
starters-bedroom.fact: Bedrooms often have a bed, wardrobe and desk.

starters-bee.definition: a small flying insect that makes sweet honey
starters-bee.definitionVi: con ong bay, làm mật ngọt
starters-bee.hint: Bees buzz and visit flowers for nectar.
starters-bee.fact: Bees dance to tell other bees where flowers are.

starters-big.definition: when something is large and takes up lots of space
starters-big.hint: An elephant is big but a mouse is small.
starters-big.fact: The opposite of big is small or little.

starters-bike.definition: a vehicle with two wheels that you pedal to move
starters-bike.hint: Always wear a helmet when you ride your bike.
starters-bike.fact: Training wheels help you learn to balance on a bike.

starters-bird.definition: an animal with feathers that can usually fly
starters-bird.definitionVi: con chim, có lông và cánh
starters-bird.hint: Birds build nests in trees to lay eggs.
starters-bird.fact: Some birds like penguins cannot fly but swim well.

starters-birthday.definition: the special day each year when you were born
starters-birthday.definitionVi: sinh nhật, ngày mình chào đời
starters-birthday.hint: People sing 'Happy Birthday' and eat cake.
starters-birthday.fact: Birthday candles show how many years old you are.

starters-black.definition: the darkest colour, like the sky at night
starters-black.hint: Crows and black cats are this colour.
starters-black.fact: Mixing all paint colours together can make black.

starters-blue.definition: the colour of a clear sky on a sunny day
starters-blue.hint: The sea often looks blue too.
starters-blue.fact: Blue is many people's favourite colour.

starters-board.definition: a flat surface for writing on, like a whiteboard
starters-board.hint: The teacher writes on the board at the front.
starters-board.fact: Whiteboards use special pens you can wipe off.

starters-board-game.definition: a game you play on a flat board with pieces and dice
starters-board-game.hint: Snakes and Ladders is a famous board game.
starters-board-game.fact: Board games are fun to play with family on rainy days.

starters-boat.definition: a vehicle that travels on water across rivers or seas
starters-boat.hint: Sailboats use wind to move across the water.
starters-boat.fact: Big boats that carry people are called ferries or ships.

starters-body.definition: all the parts of a person or animal together
starters-body.definitionVi: cơ thể, toàn bộ phần thân
starters-body.hint: Your head, arms, legs and tummy are parts of your body.
starters-body.fact: Exercise keeps your body strong and healthy.

starters-book.definition: pages with words and pictures that you read
starters-book.hint: Libraries let you borrow books for free.
starters-book.fact: Reading books before bed is a cosy bedtime habit.

starters-bookcase.definition: shelves in your home for keeping books on
starters-bookcase.hint: Put your favourite stories on the top shelf.
starters-bookcase.fact: Bookcases help keep books tidy and easy to find.

starters-bookshop.definition: a shop where you can buy books and comics
starters-bookshop.hint: Bookshops smell nice because of all the paper.
starters-bookshop.fact: Some bookshops also sell pens, cards and gifts.

starters-boots.definition: strong shoes that cover your foot and ankle
starters-boots.definitionVi: ủng, giày cao che mắt cá chân
starters-boots.hint: Wear boots in the rain to keep your feet dry.
starters-boots.fact: Cowboy boots have a pointy toe and a small heel.

starters-bounce.definition: to spring up after a ball hits the ground
starters-bounce.hint: Basketball players bounce the ball while they run.
starters-bounce.fact: Rubber balls bounce higher than soft balls.

starters-box.definition: a container with sides and often a lid inside
starters-box.hint: Presents at Christmas often come in colourful boxes.
starters-box.fact: Cardboard boxes can be recycled to help the planet.

starters-boy.definition: a male child who is not yet a grown-up man
starters-boy.hint: A boy grows up to become a man one day.
starters-boy.fact: Every boy and girl starts life as a baby.

starters-bread.definition: soft baked food made from flour, often sliced for sandwiches
starters-bread.definitionVi: bánh mì, ăn sáng rất quen
starters-bread.hint: Toast is bread warmed until it is crispy.
starters-bread.fact: People have eaten bread for thousands of years.

starters-breakfast.definition: the first meal you eat when you wake up in the morning
starters-breakfast.definitionVi: bữa sáng, ăn sau khi thức dậy
starters-breakfast.hint: Cereal, eggs and toast are popular breakfast foods.
starters-breakfast.fact: Breakfast gives you energy for school in the morning.

starters-brother.definition: a boy who has the same mum and dad as you
starters-brother.definitionVi: anh em trai trong gia đình
starters-brother.hint: Your brother might share a bedroom with you.
starters-brother.fact: Brothers and sisters are called siblings.

starters-brown.definition: the colour of chocolate, tree bark or a teddy bear
starters-brown.hint: A brown bear has fur this colour.
starters-brown.fact: Brown is made by mixing red, yellow and blue paint.

starters-burger.definition: minced meat in a round bread roll, often with salad
starters-burger.hint: Some burgers use chicken or beans instead of beef.
starters-burger.fact: The name 'hamburger' comes from a city in Germany.

starters-bus.definition: a big road vehicle that carries lots of people
starters-bus.definitionVi: xe buýt, xe bus chở nhiều người
starters-bus.hint: School buses are often bright yellow.
starters-bus.fact: Buses follow a route with stops along the way.

starters-cake.definition: a sweet baked food eaten at birthdays and parties
starters-cake.definitionVi: bánh ngọt, thường ăn sinh nhật
starters-cake.hint: Birthday cakes often have candles on top.
starters-cake.fact: The first slice of cake is sometimes for the birthday person.

starters-camera.definition: a machine that takes photos of people and places
starters-camera.hint: Say 'cheese' when someone takes your photo!
starters-camera.fact: Phone cameras let you take pictures anywhere you go.

starters-can.definition: to be able to do something if you try
starters-can.hint: 'I can swim' means you know how to swim.
starters-can.fact: 'Can' is one of the most useful little words in English.

starters-candy.definition: sweet food like lollipops, gummies and hard sweets
starters-candy.hint: Brush your teeth after eating candy.
starters-candy.fact: Halloween is a time when children collect lots of candy.

starters-car.definition: a road vehicle with four wheels for a small group
starters-car.hint: Always buckle your seatbelt in a car.
starters-car.fact: Electric cars run on batteries instead of petrol.

starters-carrot.definition: a long orange vegetable that is crunchy and healthy
starters-carrot.hint: Rabbits in stories love crunching on carrots.
starters-carrot.fact: Carrots help keep your eyes healthy.

starters-cat.definition: a small furry pet that purrs and says meow
starters-cat.definitionVi: con mèo, thú cưng hay kêu meo meo
starters-cat.hint: Cats use their tongues to clean their fur.
starters-cat.fact: Cats sleep up to sixteen hours a day!

starters-catch.definition: to grab something that is thrown or falling through the air
starters-catch.hint: Throw and catch a ball with a friend.
starters-catch.fact: Goalkeepers catch the ball to stop a goal.

starters-chair.definition: a piece of furniture that you sit on at a table
starters-chair.hint: Pull your chair in quietly at school.
starters-chair.fact: Some chairs have four legs and a back to lean on.

starters-chicken.definition: a farm bird kept for eggs and meat; it says cluck
starters-chicken.definitionVi: con gà, hay ở trên nông trại
starters-chicken.hint: Roast chicken is a popular dinner food.
starters-chicken.fact: A mother chicken is called a hen.

starters-child.definition: a young boy or girl who is not yet an adult
starters-child.hint: Every adult was once a child like you.
starters-child.fact: Children learn new languages very quickly.

starters-chips.definition: thin fried potato sticks that are salty and crispy
starters-chips.hint: In the UK, 'chips' can mean thick fried potatoes too.
starters-chips.fact: Potatoes grow underground before they become chips.

starters-chocolate.definition: a sweet brown food made from cocoa beans
starters-chocolate.hint: Chocolate bars are a favourite treat for many kids.
starters-chocolate.fact: Hot chocolate is a warm drink made with milk.

starters-choose.definition: to pick the one you want from two or more options
starters-choose.hint: You choose your favourite flavour of ice cream.
starters-choose.fact: Choosing kindly shows you care about others too.

starters-clap.definition: to hit your open hands together to make a loud sound
starters-clap.hint: People clap to say well done after a show.
starters-clap.fact: Clapping in rhythm can turn into a fun game.

starters-class.definition: a group of pupils who learn together with one teacher
starters-class.definitionVi: lớp học, các bạn học chung
starters-class.hint: Your class might have a pet hamster or goldfish.
starters-class.fact: Class photos help you remember your school friends.

starters-classmate.definition: another child who is in the same class as you
starters-classmate.hint: Sit next to a classmate you can work well with.
starters-classmate.fact: Classmates often become friends for many years.

starters-classroom.definition: the room at school where your lessons take place
starters-classroom.hint: Classrooms have desks, chairs and a board.
starters-classroom.fact: Some classrooms have computers and colourful posters.

starters-clean.definition: when something has no dirt or mess on it
starters-clean.hint: Wash your hands to keep them clean before eating.
starters-clean.fact: Tidy rooms feel nice and help you find things.

starters-clock.definition: something on the wall or wrist that shows the time
starters-clock.definitionVi: đồng hồ cho biết mấy giờ
starters-clock.hint: Look at the clock to know when break time is.
starters-clock.fact: Big clocks on towers often chime every hour.

starters-close.definition: to shut something like a door, window or book
starters-close.hint: Close the door quietly so you do not wake the baby.
starters-close.fact: Shops close the door when they finish for the day.

starters-closed.definition: when a shop or door is not open for people
starters-closed.hint: A sign on the door tells you if a shop is closed.
starters-closed.fact: Libraries and schools are closed on some holidays.

starters-clothes.definition: things like shirts, trousers and dresses that you wear
starters-clothes.hint: Hang wet clothes on a line to dry in the sun.
starters-clothes.fact: Different clothes suit hot weather and cold weather.

starters-coconut.definition: a big brown fruit with white flesh and sweet water inside
starters-coconut.definitionVi: quả dừa, có nước ngọt bên trong
starters-coconut.hint: Coconut grows on tall palm trees near beaches.
starters-coconut.fact: The hard shell of a coconut protects the soft inside.

starters-colour.definition: a shade like red, blue or green that things can be
starters-colour.definitionVi: màu sắc như đỏ, xanh, vàng
starters-colour.hint: Mix red and yellow paint to make orange.
starters-colour.fact: A rainbow shows seven beautiful colours in the sky.

starters-come.definition: to move toward the person who is speaking
starters-come.hint: Mum might say 'Come here!' when she needs you.

starters-complete.definition: to finish all parts of your work or homework
starters-complete.hint: Check your answers when you complete a worksheet.
starters-complete.fact: Completing a puzzle feels really satisfying!

starters-computer.definition: a machine for typing, games and learning at school
starters-computer.definitionVi: máy tính để học và chơi
starters-computer.hint: Use a mouse or touchpad to move on the screen.
starters-computer.fact: Computers can connect to the internet for videos and facts.

starters-cool.definition: when the weather feels a little cold but not freezing
starters-cool.hint: Wear a jacket on a cool autumn day.
starters-cool.fact: Cool breezes feel nice after a hot summer day.

starters-correct.definition: when an answer or spelling has no mistakes
starters-correct.hint: The teacher puts a tick when your work is correct.
starters-correct.fact: It is okay to make mistakes — they help you learn!

starters-count.definition: to say numbers in order: one, two, three, four
starters-count.hint: Count your fingers — you always have ten!
starters-count.fact: People count steps, stars and coins every day.

starters-cousin.definition: the child of your aunt or uncle in your family
starters-cousin.hint: Cousins often visit at holidays and birthdays.
starters-cousin.fact: You might play with cousins at family gatherings.

starters-cow.definition: a big farm animal that gives us milk to drink
starters-cow.hint: Cows eat grass in green fields all day.
starters-cow.fact: A baby cow is called a calf.

starters-crayon.definition: a coloured stick of wax used for drawing pictures
starters-crayon.definitionVi: bút sáp màu để tô tranh
starters-crayon.hint: Crayons come in a box of many bright colours.
starters-crayon.fact: Pressing hard with a crayon makes a darker colour.

starters-crocodile.definition: a big reptile with a long mouth and sharp teeth
starters-crocodile.definitionVi: cá sấu, miệng dài và răng nhọn
starters-crocodile.hint: Crocodiles live in rivers in hot countries.
starters-crocodile.fact: Crocodiles have been on Earth since dinosaur times.

starters-cross.definition: a mark shaped like an X or a plus sign
starters-cross.hint: Teachers put a cross when an answer is wrong.
starters-cross.fact: A red cross is a famous sign for hospitals.

starters-cupboard.definition: a cabinet with doors where you store cups and food
starters-cupboard.hint: Plates and bowls are kept in the kitchen cupboard.
starters-cupboard.fact: Cupboards keep food safe from dust and insects.

starters-dad.definition: another friendly word for your father at home
starters-dad.hint: Dad might read you a bedtime story.
starters-dad.fact: Father, dad and daddy all mean the same person.

starters-day.definition: twenty-four hours from morning through to night
starters-day.definitionVi: một ngày, từ sáng đến tối
starters-day.hint: There are seven days in one week.
starters-day.fact: Saturday and Sunday are often called the weekend.

starters-desk.definition: a table at school where you sit and write
starters-desk.hint: Keep your pencils and rubber inside your desk.
starters-desk.fact: Some desks have a lift-up lid for storing books.

starters-dining-room.definition: the room at home where the family eats meals together
starters-dining-room.hint: The dining room often has a big table and chairs.
starters-dining-room.fact: Families talk about their day while eating in the dining room.

starters-dinner.definition: the main meal that most people eat in the evening
starters-dinner.definitionVi: bữa tối, ăn buổi chiều tối
starters-dinner.hint: Dinner might be pasta, rice or soup.
starters-dinner.fact: Saying 'thank you' after dinner is good manners.

starters-dirty.definition: when something has mud, dust or marks on it
starters-dirty.hint: Dirty shoes should stay at the door.
starters-dirty.fact: Washing up turns dirty plates into clean ones.

starters-dog.definition: a friendly pet that barks and wags its tail
starters-dog.definitionVi: con chó, thú cưng trung thành
starters-dog.hint: Walk your dog every day so it stays happy.
starters-dog.fact: Dogs can learn tricks like sit, stay and fetch.

starters-doll.definition: a toy shaped like a baby or person to play with
starters-doll.hint: Some dolls have clothes you can change.
starters-doll.fact: Doll houses are tiny homes for dolls to live in.

starters-donkey.definition: a grey farm animal a bit like a small horse
starters-donkey.definitionVi: con lừa, hay ở nông trại
starters-donkey.hint: Donkeys say hee-haw instead of neigh.
starters-donkey.fact: Donkeys carry heavy loads on farms and in deserts.

starters-door.definition: what you open and close to go in or out of a room
starters-door.hint: Knock on the door before you enter a room.
starters-door.fact: Front doors often have a letter box for post.

starters-double.definition: twice as much or two of exactly the same thing
starters-double.hint: Double six on dice means you rolled two sixes.
starters-double.fact: A double-decker bus has two floors of seats!

starters-draw.definition: to make a picture using a pencil, pen or crayon
starters-draw.hint: Start with simple shapes like circles and squares.
starters-draw.fact: Drawing every day makes your pictures better and better.

starters-drawing.definition: a picture that someone made with pencil or crayon
starters-drawing.hint: Pin your best drawing on the fridge at home.
starters-drawing.fact: Art galleries hang famous drawings for everyone to see.

starters-dress.definition: a piece of clothing that covers the body in one piece
starters-dress.hint: Party dresses are often bright and pretty.
starters-dress.fact: Dresses can be long or short and come in many patterns.

starters-drink.definition: a liquid like water, juice or milk that you swallow
starters-drink.definitionVi: đồ uống như nước, sữa, nước cam
starters-drink.hint: Drink water when you feel thirsty after running.
starters-drink.fact: Milk and fruit juice give you vitamins as you drink.

starters-drive.definition: to control a car and make it move along the road
starters-drive.hint: Grown-ups need a licence before they can drive.
starters-drive.fact: Always look both ways before crossing where cars drive.

starters-duck.definition: a bird that swims on ponds and says quack
starters-duck.definitionVi: con vịt, bơi trên ao và kêu cạc cạc
starters-duck.hint: Ducklings follow their mother in a line.
starters-duck.fact: Ducks have webbed feet to help them paddle in water.

starters-ear.definition: the part on the side of your head that you hear with
starters-ear.hint: Earrings are small decorations some people wear on ears.
starters-ear.fact: Your ears help you balance when you walk and run.

starters-eat.definition: to put food in your mouth, chew it and swallow
starters-eat.definitionVi: ăn, nhai và nuốt thức ăn
starters-eat.hint: Eat slowly and chew well — it helps your tummy.
starters-eat.fact: People eat with forks, spoons or chopsticks in different countries.

starters-egg.definition: a round food from chickens used in cooking and baking
starters-egg.definitionVi: quả trứng gà, dùng nấu ăn
starters-egg.hint: Boiled eggs are soft inside with a white shell outside.
starters-egg.fact: Chickens lay eggs in nests on farms.

starters-elephant.definition: the biggest land animal with a long trunk and big ears
starters-elephant.hint: Elephants use their trunk like a long nose and arm.
starters-elephant.fact: Elephants can squirt water over themselves to stay cool.

starters-end.definition: the last part of a story, game or school day
starters-end.hint: The end of a book often says 'The End'.
starters-end.fact: School ends with a bell ringing in many countries.

starters-enjoy.definition: to have fun and feel happy while doing something
starters-enjoy.definitionVi: thích, vui vẻ khi làm gì đó
starters-enjoy.hint: Say 'I enjoy reading' about your favourite hobby.
starters-enjoy.fact: Enjoying music can make you want to dance!

starters-eraser.definition: a small rubber that rubs out pencil mistakes on paper
starters-eraser.definitionVi: cục tẩy, xóa chì trên giấy
starters-eraser.hint: Rub gently so you do not tear the paper.
starters-eraser.fact: Erasers often come at the end of a pencil.

starters-evening.definition: the time after afternoon when the sky gets darker
starters-evening.definitionVi: buổi tối, trời bắt đầu tối
starters-evening.hint: Families often eat dinner together in the evening.
starters-evening.fact: Stars begin to appear in the evening sky.

starters-example.definition: one thing that shows what you mean in a lesson
starters-example.definitionVi: ví dụ, minh họa trong bài học
starters-example.hint: Teachers say 'for example' before giving an example.
starters-example.fact: Examples make new ideas easier to understand.

starters-eye.definition: the part of your face that you use to see with
starters-eye.hint: Blink your eyes to keep them wet and clean.
starters-eye.fact: Brown, blue and green are common eye colours.

starters-face.definition: the front part of your head with eyes, nose and mouth
starters-face.definitionVi: khuôn mặt, có mắt mũi miệng
starters-face.hint: Wash your face every morning when you get up.
starters-face.fact: Smiling uses muscles all over your face.

starters-family.definition: mum, dad, brothers, sisters and other people who love you
starters-family.definitionVi: gia đình, người thân yêu mình
starters-family.hint: Draw a family tree to show who is related to you.
starters-family.fact: Families can be big or small but full of love.

starters-fantastic.definition: when something is really great and makes you excited
starters-fantastic.hint: Say 'fantastic!' when your team wins a game.
starters-fantastic.fact: Fantastic comes from a word about magic and fantasy.

starters-father.definition: a male parent who takes care of his children
starters-father.hint: Father's Day is a special day to thank your dad.
starters-father.fact: Father, dad and daddy are different names for the same person.

starters-favourite.definition: the one you like more than anything else
starters-favourite.hint: What is your favourite colour or food?
starters-favourite.fact: Favourite is spelled 'favorite' in American English.

starters-find.definition: to discover something you lost or were looking for
starters-find.hint: Hide-and-seek is a game where you find your friends.
starters-find.fact: Treasure hunts give clues to help you find a prize.

starters-fishing.definition: catching fish with a rod, line and hook near water
starters-fishing.hint: You need patience and quiet when you go fishing.
starters-fishing.fact: Some people throw the fish back after catching it.

starters-flat.definition: a home inside one building that has many other homes
starters-flat.definitionVi: căn hộ, nhà trong chung cư
starters-flat.hint: Flats often have a number like Flat 4B on the door.
starters-flat.fact: In America people often say 'apartment' instead of flat.

starters-floor.definition: the flat surface inside a room that you walk on
starters-floor.definitionVi: sàn nhà, mặt sàn trong phòng
starters-floor.hint: Sit on the floor for circle time at school.
starters-floor.fact: Some floors are wood, carpet or shiny tiles.

starters-flower.definition: the colourful part of a plant that often smells nice
starters-flower.hint: Bees visit flowers to collect sweet nectar.
starters-flower.fact: Roses and sunflowers are two popular types of flower.

starters-fly.definition: to move through the air like a bird or aeroplane
starters-fly.hint: Paper aeroplanes can fly across the classroom.
starters-fly.fact: Butterflies and bees fly but chickens mostly walk.

starters-food.definition: anything you eat or drink to stay strong and healthy
starters-food.hint: Fruit, vegetables, bread and rice are all food.
starters-food.fact: Different countries have different favourite foods.

starters-foot.definition: the part at the end of your leg that you stand on
starters-foot.hint: You have ten toes on your two feet.
starters-foot.fact: Shoes and socks keep your feet warm and protected.

starters-football.definition: a game where teams kick a ball to score goals
starters-football.definitionVi: bóng đá, đá bóng vào khung thành
starters-football.hint: Only the goalkeeper can use hands in football.
starters-football.fact: Football is the most popular sport in the world.

starters-friend.definition: someone you like, trust and enjoy playing with
starters-friend.hint: Good friends share toys and say sorry when needed.
starters-friend.fact: Making a new friend starts with a smile and hello.

starters-fries.definition: thin hot strips of fried potato served with salt
starters-fries.hint: Fries are often eaten with ketchup or mayonnaise.
starters-fries.fact: Some people call them French fries or chips.

starters-frog.definition: a small green animal that jumps and lives near water
starters-frog.definitionVi: con ếch xanh, nhảy và sống gần nước
starters-frog.hint: Frogs start life as tiny tadpoles in ponds.
starters-frog.fact: Frogs say ribbit and catch flies with a long tongue.

starters-fruit.definition: sweet food that grows on trees and plants, like apples
starters-fruit.hint: Eat five portions of fruit and vegetables every day.
starters-fruit.fact: Tomatoes are fruit even though we cook them like vegetables.

starters-fun.definition: when something makes you laugh and feel very happy
starters-fun.hint: Playgrounds, games and parties are lots of fun.
starters-fun.fact: Having fun with friends is good for your mood.

starters-funny.definition: when something makes you laugh or giggle a lot
starters-funny.hint: Funny jokes often have a surprise at the end.
starters-funny.fact: Clowns and cartoons use silly faces to look funny.
